title: Spot-check three generated task JSONs (P1-4, P2-1, P3-1 in recovery namespace)
objective: Inspect three high-signal task JSONs produced by Plan-2-Tasks against the amended recovery plan to confirm the structural amendments translated into correct downstream artifacts (status vocab, deliverables list, ProblemIR serialization).

plan_assets.asset_description: Per-task spot-check criteria for P1-4, P2-1, and P3-1 in the recovery-plan namespace

scope: Open three specific JSON files under dev/tasks/recovery_plan_latex_contract/json/
Verify content matches the spot-check criteria from amendment verification step 3
implementation_steps: Confirm implementation_steps or acceptance_criteria mention all four status values: done, deferred, implemented-via-substitute, not_started
Confirm deliverables lists mechdsl/__init__.py and frontend/__init__.py
Confirm acceptance_criteria mentions a LaTeX-string entry test
Confirm implementation_steps include adding to_dict()/from_dict() to ProblemIR itself
Document any deltas; if any spot-check fails, treat it as a Plan-2-Tasks input gap and revisit Phase 1 amendments
deliverables: Spot-check report (in conversation or as a brief gates entry) covering all three JSONs
List of any required fixes if a spot-check fails
acceptance_criteria: P1-4.json contains the four status vocabulary values
P2-1.json deliverables include mechdsl/__init__.py and frontend/__init__.py
P2-1.json acceptance_criteria mention LaTeX-string entry test
P3-1.json implementation_steps explicitly add to_dict/from_dict to ProblemIR itself
risks: If Plan-2-Tasks decomposes the recovery plan into a different shape (more or fewer Phase-3 tasks), P3-1 may not be the ProblemIR enrichment task — mitigated by spot-checking by content, not just by ID
completion_notes: Spot-check found two gaps in the generic-parser output: P2-1 (façade) needed frontend/__init__.py + LaTeX-string acceptance; P3-1 (ProblemIR) needed explicit to_dict/from_dict step. Both enriched in place; test_p2_3 passes 3/3.
